disambiguation.text:
### 12. Entity definitions and three levels of difference

- **Revelation First** — the framework (#202): the Apocalypse first composed, the other books unfolding from it. Distinct from **Revelation Early**, the pre-70 dating, which the framework's seed sets apart by its title.
- **The midrashim transform** — a structural-genetic mapping from a compressed form in the Apocalypse to an elaborated one elsewhere (#202), bounded in the kernel by the transform procedure; distinct from the rabbinic tradition of Midrash.
- **The Josephus thesis** — an available heteronymic reading of New Testament author-functions (#203), rung V, contingent; distinct from the Piso hypothesis and the Jesus-myth thesis (#837).
